chapter: Practice, Indianapolis memories and the trombone
title: The Montgomerys together and apart
summary: The Montgomery brothers were musically close; socially Hampton hung out with Buddy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When you’re interacting with the Montgomery family, would it be all of the brothers, or just Buddy?
Even though they’re like 10 years apart.
Well, in social life, then they weren’t.

Musically, every day they were together. Social life, my brother and I were hanging out with Buddy. The other guys, the older guys, of course were somewhere else. Wes was hanging out with one group of people, and Monk was hanging out somewhere else.
